title: Cheese-Crusted Beef Enchiladas
subtitle: with saucy black bean chilli, corn salsa & chive crème fraîche
description: This ready-in-4-steps Mexican comfort food will warm you up this winter. Spiced beef and black bean ragù wrapped up inside a flour tortilla, smothered in cheese and baked until crispy and golden. Topped with a charred sweet corn & jalapeño salsa and chive crème fraîche. Speedy and Yum!

instructions.title: TEXI-MEXI RAGÙ
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Boil the kettle. Dilute the stock with 100ml of boiling water and set aside. Place a pot over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, sauté the diced onion for 4-5 minutes until soft and translucent. Add in the mince and work quickly to break it up as it starts to cook. Allow to caramelise for 6-7 minutes until browned but not cooked through, shifting occasionally. On completion, mix in the BBQ Rub and cook for 1-2 minutes. Stir in the cooked chopped tomato and diluted stock, then reduce the heat. Simmer for 12-15 minutes until reduced and thickened, stirring occasionally.

instructions.title: SPICY CORN SALSA & CHIVE CRÈME
instructions.text: Place a pan over a high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the drained corn for 3-4 minutes until charred, shifting occasionally. On completion, transfer to a bowl and add the chopped jalapeños to taste. Toss to combine, season, and set aside for serving. In a small bowl, combine the crème fraîche, ½ of the chopped chives, and some seasoning. Set aside for serving.

instructions.title: ROLL 'EM UP
instructions.text: When the ragù has 2 minutes remaining, stir through the drained black beans to heat through. On completion, remove from the heat and season to taste with salt, pepper, and sweetener of choice (optional). Grease a roasting tray or ovenproof dish with a little butter or oil. Spread the ragù evenly over the tortillas and roll each one up into a tube. Place on the tray or dish and top with the grated cheese. Bake in the hot oven for 4-5 minutes until crisping up and golden.

instructions.title: TIME TO DINE
instructions.text: Plate up the cheesy beef enchiladas and sprinkle over the corn and jalapeño salsa. Dollop over the chive crème fraîche and garnish with the remaining chives. Tuck in!
